blocks.en: Abstract
blocks.zh: 摘要

blocks.en:
Dental cone-beam computed tomography (CBCT) systems often employ detector
configurations that provide a truncated field of view (FOV) that only captures a small part of the patient’s anatomy. In this work, we aim to reconstruct an extended FOV using projections of truncated FOV scans. To this end, we propose a three-stage framework that consists of (1) an implicit neural representation (INR) for estimating missing parts of the truncated projection data, (2) an iterative reconstruction for generating a secondary volumetric image with improved anatomical consistency and (3) a fast diffusion model for image enhancement. The proposed approach combines the strengths of continuous representations, physics-based reconstruction and generative refinement within a unified pipeline for truncated CBCT imaging. Experimental results demonstrate that the method effectively reduces truncation artifacts, improves the reconstruction of structures extending beyond the original FOV and produces images with enhanced quality. Our code is
publicly available at https://github.com/SusanneSchaub/CBCT-FOV-Extension .
blocks.zh:
牙科锥束计算成像仪系统经常使用探测器
配置提供短视场(FOV),只捕捉到患者解剖学的一小部分. 在这项工作中,我们的目标是利用短程FOV扫描的预测重建扩展的FOV. 为此,我们提出了一个三阶段框架,其中包括:(1) 用于估计短线投影数据缺失部分的隐性神经表达(INR),(2) 用于生成二次体积成像的迭代重建,提高解剖一致性,(3) 图像增强的快速传播模型. 拟议的办法结合了连续表示、基于物理学的重建和基因改良等优点,在中断CBCT成像的统一管道内进行。 实验结果显示,该方法有效减少了径流文物,改进了超出原FOV的结构重建,并产生了质量更高的图像. 我们的密码是

blocks.en: 1 Introduction
blocks.zh: 导言

blocks.en: In dental cone-beam computed tomography (CBCT), compact and low-cost scanner configurations commonly rely on small detectors, yielding a limited field of view (FOV) that may not include the entire anatomy of the patient’s head. Furthermore, the use of a small FOV in CBCT is recommended whenever clinically feasible, as it indirectly helps to reduce the radiation dose received by the patient. However, restricting the FOV results in missing projection data, rendering the reconstruction problem ill-posed.
blocks.zh: 在牙科圆锥束计算成像仪(CBCT)中,紧凑和低成本的扫描仪配置通常依靠小型探测器,产生有限的视野(FOV),可能不包括病人头部的整个解剖学. 此外,建议在临床上可行时在CBCT中使用小型FOV,因为它间接有助于减少患者收到的辐射剂量。 然而,由于对现场调查的限制,导致缺少预测数据,使重建问题难以掌握。

blocks.en: A wide range of approaches have been developed to address the problem of FOV extension using truncated projection data. Classical methods do sinogram completion analytically or by fitting simple shapes to enforce projection consistency and then use the FDK-algorithm [ 4 ] or iterative reconstruction techniques to reconstruct the volumetric images [ 7 ] . Iterative reconstruction methods with several different regularizations have been proposed for CT reconstruction [ 16 ] . However, applying iterative reconstruction approaches to truncated projections leads to an incomplete forward model, leaving attenuation values outside the measured FOV weakly constrained. As a result, reconstruction errors associated with the missing data propagate throughout the iterative optimization, producing truncation artifacts and degrading image quality.
blocks.zh: 已经开发了多种办法,利用短线预测数据解决FOV扩展问题。 经典方法在分析上或通过安装简单的形状来强制进行投影一致性,然后使用FDK-算法[4]或迭代重建技术来重塑卷片图像[7]. 为CT重建提出了几种不同的正规化的迭代重建方法[16]. 然而,采用迭代重建方法进行短线预测,导致前期模型不完整,使所测FOV以外的衰减值受到微弱制约。 因此,与缺失数据相关的重建错误在整个迭代优化过程中传播,产生了截断文物,降低了图像质量.

blocks.en: Alongside these classical methods, multiple learning-based techniques have emerged. Since CBCT generates a large amount of projection data, methods operating in the projection domain are often computationally expensive and memory-intensive. To mitigate this challenge, image-to-image-translation methods are typically adopted on a slice-wise basis [ 8 , 10 , 19 ] . Moreover, learning-based approaches that operate in both the projection and image reconstruction domains have also been proposed [ 5 , 6 ] .
blocks.zh: 除了这些古典方法,还出现了多种基于学习的技术. 由于CBCT生成大量投影数据,在投影领域运行的方法往往在计算上昂贵且内存密集. 为了减轻这一挑战,图像到图像的翻译方法通常采用切片法[8、10、19]。 此外,还提出了在投影和图像重建两个领域都运作的基于学习的办法[5、6]。

blocks.en: Figure 1: An INR first extends the FOV of truncated projections, followed by iterative reconstruction and diffusion-based refinement to recover lost detail.
blocks.zh: 图1:国家自然资源研究所首先扩展了短线预测的视野,然后是迭代重建和传播改进,以恢复丢失的细节。

blocks.en: Diffusion models have proven to be capable of generating state-of-the-art results in generative modeling and outperform generative adversarial networks. These models have been applied to address several challenges in CBCT imaging, including limited-angle CBCT reconstruction [ 18 ] . Some recent works [ 9 , 10 ] leverage these models to recover the CT FOV.
blocks.zh: 事实证明,扩散模型能够产生最新结果,形成基因模型,并超越基因对抗网络。 这些模型被用于应对CBCT成像中的几个挑战,包括有限角的CBCT重建[18]. 最近的一些作品[9,10]利用这些模型来回收CT FOV.

blocks.en:
More recently, implicit neural representations (INRs) have emerged as a promising approach for addressing ill-posed inverse problems, including sparse-view CBCT reconstruction [ 21 , 22 ] . INRs are used for CBCT reconstruction by formulating the problem as the optimization of a continuous attenuation field. This continuous representation allows the attenuation field to be evaluated at arbitrary spatial locations, removing the constraint of a fixed voxel resolution. Since the entire attenuation field is parameterized by a single neural network, each optimization step updates a globally consistent representation influenced by all projection views. These properties make INRs well suited for CBCT FOV extension, as they reduce truncation artifacts and enable estimation of attenuation values outside the measured FOV while maintaining consistency with the acquired projection data. However, the application of INRs to truncated-FOV extension remains largely unexplored. Existing work has shown that incorporating INR-based coarse-grid
priors into an iterative reconstruction framework can mitigate truncation artifacts and improve the visibility of low-contrast structures compared with conventional iterative reconstruction methods that do not employ a coarse-grid prior [ 13 ] .
blocks.zh:
最近,隐含的神经表达作为解决不良反向问题的一种有希望的办法出现,包括零星的CBCT重建[21,22]。 综合营养素用于CBCT的重建,其方法是将问题表述为持续衰减场的优化。 这种连续的表示使衰减场能够在任意的空间位置上被评价,从而消除了固定的阴离子分辨率的制约. 由于整个衰减场由一个单一神经网络参数化,每个优化步骤都会更新一个受所有投影观点影响的全球一致的表示. 这些特性使综合营养素非常适合CBCT FOV扩展,因为它们减少了切变文物,并使得能够估计所测量的FOV以外的衰减值,同时与获得的预测数据保持一致。 然而,对截断式FOV扩展的IRRs的应用基本上仍未加以探讨。 现有工作显示,已纳入基于国家自然资源研究所的粗网。
与传统迭代重建方法相比,进入迭代重建框架的前身可以减轻断流文物,提高低混凝土结构的能见度,而传统迭代重建方法在[13]之前不使用粗网.

blocks.en: In this work, we propose a three-stage approach consisting of INR-based projection completion, iterative image reconstruction and diffusion model-based image refinement. The inference process is shown in Fig. 1 .
blocks.zh: 在这项工作中,我们提出一个三阶段方法,包括基于INR的投影完成,迭代图像重建和传播模型的图像改进. 图1显示了推断过程。

blocks.en: 2.2 Pipeline
blocks.zh: 2.2 管道

blocks.en:
First an INR was trained to overfit the truncated projection data following [ 22 ] . We extended this implementation with three modifications: (i) a total variation (TV) regularization term to encourage spatial smoothness and suppress high-frequency fluctuations. The network predicts a randomly shifted 32 3 32^{3} voxel grid V V , on which spatial gradients along the three coordinate axes are penalized: ℒ TV = λ ​ ∑ ( i , j , k ) ∈ Ω ( V i + 1 , j , k − V i , j , k ) 2 + ( V i , j + 1 , k − V i , j , k ) 2 + ( V i , j , k + 1 − V i , j , k ) 2 , \mathcal{L}_{\text{TV}}=\lambda\sum_{(i,j,k)\in\Omega}\sqrt{(V_{i+1,j,k}-V_{i,j,k})^{2}+(V_{i,j+1,k}-V_{i,j,k})^{2}+(V_{i,j,k+1}-V_{i,j,k})^{2}}, (3) where we set λ = 10 − 5 \lambda=10^{-5} empirically.
Further, (ii) we add a normalization layer between the hash-grid encoding and the neural network [ 20 ] and (iii) a hash-grid encoding regularization to improve reconstruction quality following [ 15 ] . After training, the INR was used to render extended projections corresponding to an enlarged FOV. These projections were subsequently reconstructed into a volumetric image using the iterative OS-SART algorithm [ 2 ] . In both datasets, we reconstructed volumes of shape 256 × 256 × 256 256\times 256\times 256 . For the MMDental dataset, the voxel size was set to 0.9 mm 0.9\text{\,}\mathrm{mm} , while for the pig jaw dataset it was 1.0 mm 1.0\text{\,}\mathrm{mm} .

此外,(二)在散列电网编码与神经网络之间增加一个正常化层[20]和(三)散列电网编码规范,以提高[15]后的重建质量. 培训后,使用了综合营养素,对扩大的野生生物进行扩展预测。 这些预测随后使用迭代OS-SART算法重建成量子图像[2]. 在两个数据集中,我们重建了256×256×256×256\times256\times的体积. 对于MMDental数据集,voxel大小被设定为0.9mm 0.9\text~,}\ mathrm{mm},而对于猪下巴数据集则被设定为1.0mm 1.0\text~,}\ mathrm{mm}.

blocks.en:
Finally, a conditional diffusion model was applied to recover fine anatomical details. The architecture of the diffusion model is based on the 2D denoising diffusion probabilistic model (DDPM) approach proposed in [ 11 ] . To accelerate inference, we introduced several modifications, including a variance-preserving noise schedule with a linearly varying noise intensity and the use of an L 1 L_{1} loss, following the approach of [ 3 ] .
We set the number of diffusion steps to three based on empirical evaluation of different numbers of diffusion steps. We adopted a slice-wise approach to address memory constraints and limited training data, as CBCT reconstructions typically involve large volumetric datasets.
blocks.zh:
最后,还采用了有条件的传播模型来回收细微解剖细节。 扩散模型的结构基于[11]中提议的2D减号扩散概率模型(DDPM)方法. 为了加快推论,我们进行了一些修改,包括采用线性变化的噪声强度的偏移保留噪声表,以及采用L 1 LQQ1}损失,采用[3] 的方法。
我们根据对不同数量的传播步骤的实证评估,将传播步骤的数目定为三个。 我们采取了片面的方法来解决内存限制和有限的培训数据,因为CBCT的重建通常涉及大量的量产数据集.

blocks.en: 2.3 Datasets
blocks.zh: 2.3 数据集

blocks.en:
We used the publicly available MMDental dataset [ 17 ] , comprising 403 dental CBCT scans. Of these, 40 scans were used for validation and 40 for testing. We resized the scans to the size of 256 × 256 × 256 256\times 256\times 256 . The open-source toolbox TIGRE [ 1 ] was used to generate 300 300 projection views of size 256 × 256 256\times 256 in the range of 0 ∘ ∼ 360 ∘ 0^{\circ}\sim 360^{\circ} with an isotropic pixel size of 3.0 mm 3.0\text{\,}\mathrm{mm} . We set the source-to-detector distance to 1500 mm 1500\text{\,}\mathrm{mm} and the detector-to-object distance to 700 mm 700\text{\,}\mathrm{mm} . Poisson and Gaussian noise were added to the projections to simulate realistic acquisition conditions. The projections were then cropped along the width dimension to create truncated projections of varying sizes, with crop widths ranging from 150 to 200 pixels. To mimic reconstructions acquired at different small-FOV locations, the image volume was shifted by multiple physical offsets relative to the center of the original scans.
In addition, we validated the proposed method on a smaller dataset comprising 16 large FOV CBCT scans of pig jaws. More details on the CBCT units and the acquisition parameters can be found in [ 12 , 14 ] . We used one mandible for validation and one for testing. Each mandible was scanned using four different CBCT units. We resized the scans to the size of 256 × 256 × 256 256\times 256\times 256 and generated 500 500 projection views of size 512 × 512 512\times 512 in the range of 0 ∘ ∼ 360 ∘ 0^{\circ}\sim 360^{\circ} with an isotropic pixel size of 1.0 mm 1.0\text{\,}\mathrm{mm} . We used the same source-to-detector distance and detector-to-object distance as for the MMDental dataset. To crop the FOV, we removed 200 pixels from the width while keeping the projection height unchanged.

blocks.en: 2.4 Implementation Details
blocks.zh: 2.4 执行细节

blocks.en: Our models are implemented in PyTorch. The INR is composed of a hash-grid encoding followed by a 4-layer ReLU mutilayer perceptron with 32 hidden units. The encoding uses 20 multiresolution levels, each storing 4-dimensional feature vectors, with a base grid resolution of 16 and a hash map containing 2 21 2^{21} entries. We trained the INR for 30 epochs on the MMDental dataset and 100 epochs on the pig jaw dataset using an initial learning rate of 1 × 10 − 3 1\times 10^{-3} , which was reduced to 1 × 10 − 4 1\times 10^{-4} halfway through training. A batch size of 32,768 rays was used in each iteration.

The DDPM was trained for 150,000 iterations on the MMDental dataset and 200,000 iterations on the pig jaw dataset using a batch size of 14. We optimized all models using the Adam optimizer. More details on the empirically selected hyperparameters for the INR and diffusion model are provided in our code. All experiments were carried out on a single
NVIDIA A100 (40 GB) GPU.
blocks.zh:
DDPM在MMDental数据集上接受了15万次迭代的培训,在猪下巴数据集上接受了20万次迭代的培训,使用批量尺寸为14. 我们利用亚当优化器优化了所有模型. 我们的代码中提供了以经验方式选择的超参数的更多细节,用于IRN和传播模型。 所有实验都是在单人身上进行的

blocks.en: 2.5 Comparing Methods
blocks.zh: 2.5 比较方法

blocks.en: We compared the proposed approach with several baseline methods, which are listed below. In addition, we conducted ablation studies by removing either the INR component or the diffusion-based refinement stage. We conducted the main evaluation on the MMDental dataset and evaluated only the best-performing methods on the pig jaw dataset. • Conventional Reconstruction Methods: Three non-learning-based reconstruction methods: the analytical FDK algorithm, the iterative OS-SART algorithm and OS-SART with a TV regularization. • CT-Palette: A conditional diffusion model that predicts the full untruncated reconstruction by conditioning on both the truncated image and the mask showing the image parts to be inpainted used to generate the truncated image from the ground truth. We injected noise only into the region to be inpainted. Our implementation is based on the method proposed by CT-Palette in [ 10 ] , with modifications adapted to our experimental settings. • INR-based Projection Correction (INR-PC-IR): A fast conditional 3D wavelet diffusion model [ 3 ] was trained on the INR extended projections of size 256 × 256 × 256 256\times 256\times 256 . The projections generated by the diffusion model were subsequently interpolated to yield projections of size 300 × 256 × 256 300\times 256\times 256 to compare with the ground truth. The original projection data from the uncropped FOV were incorporated into the diffusion model–corrected projections and volumetric images were subsequently reconstructed using OS-SART. • Ablation 1: INR-based Iterative Reconstruction (INR-IR): The projections rendered by the INR were reconstructed using OS-SART, without applying the diffusion-based refinement stage of our proposed method. Before the reconstruction, we copied the original projection data corresponding to the uncropped FOV into the INR-rendered projections. • Ablation 2: Iterative Reconstruction-Prior DDPM (IR-DDPM): We used the cropped ground truth projections directly as input to the OS-SART algorithm and used the resulting volumetric images as conditions to train the fast diffusion model described in Section 2.2 . • IR Prior-WDM (IR-WDM): The iterative reconstruction using cropped projections was refined using a 3D diffusion model approach based on fastWDM [ 3 ] trained in the reconstructed image domain. • INR Prior-WDM (INR-IR-WDM): The INR-based iterative reconstruction (INR-IR) was refined using a 3D diffusion model approach based on fastWDM [ 3 ] trained in the reconstructed image domain. • INR Prior-DDPM (INR-IR-DDPM) (proposed): The diffusion-based refinement was applied to the INR-based iterative reconstruction (INR-IR) using a fast DDPM model in 2D described in Section 2.2 .
blocks.zh: 我们比较了拟议的方法与以下所列若干基准方法。 此外,我们还通过去除IRR部分或基于扩散的完善阶段,进行了消化研究。 我们对MMDental数据集进行了主要评价,并且只评价了猪下巴数据集最佳的操作方法. • 常规重建 方法: 三种基于非学习的重建方法:分析FDK算法,迭代OS-SART算法和带有电视规范化的OS-SART. • CT-Palette: 一个有条件的传播模型,通过在截断的图像和面具上同时进行调节来预测完整的未切换的重建,显示用来从地面真理中生成截断的图像的图像部分. 我们只给这个地区注入了噪音,以便涂上油漆。 我们的实施是基于CT-Palette在[10]中提出的方法,并根据我们的实验环境进行了修改。 · 以INR为基础的预测校正(INR-PC-IR): 快速有条件的3D波波传播模型[3]接受了关于INR扩展预测大小256×256×256×256×256×256×256×256的训练. 扩散模型产生的预测随后被内插,得出大小为300×256×256300×256的预测,与地面真理比较. 将未整理的FOV的原始投影数据纳入了扩散模型——修正的预测,随后利用OS-SART重建了体积图像。 • 1:基于国家自然资源研究所的迭代重建(IR): 国际自然资源研究所所作的预测是使用OS-SART进行重建的,没有采用我们拟议方法的推广改进阶段。 在重建前,我们把对应未整理的FOV的原始投影数据复制到INR的投影中. • 第2段:长期重建 -- -- 优先DDPM(IR-DDPM): 我们直接将所裁剪的地面真象预测作为OS-SART算法的输入,并将所产生的量子图像作为条件来训练第2.2节所述的快速扩散模型。 利用栽培的预测进行的迭代重建利用基于快速WDM[3]在重建图像领域培训的三维传播模型方法进行了改进。 • INR President-WDM(IR-IR-WDM): 基于INR的迭代重建(INR-IR)是使用基于快速WDM[3]在重建图像领域培训的3D扩散模型方法加以改进的. • INR POR-DDPM(IR-DDPM)(拟议): 基于传播的改进应用到基于IR的迭代重建(INR-IR)中使用了第2.2节描述的2D中的快速DDPM模型.

blocks.en: Conventional Reconstruction Methods: Three non-learning-based reconstruction methods: the analytical FDK algorithm, the iterative OS-SART algorithm and OS-SART with a TV regularization.
blocks.zh: 常规重建 方法: 三种基于非学习的重建方法:分析FDK算法,迭代OS-SART算法和带有电视规范化的OS-SART.

blocks.en: CT-Palette: A conditional diffusion model that predicts the full untruncated reconstruction by conditioning on both the truncated image and the mask showing the image parts to be inpainted used to generate the truncated image from the ground truth. We injected noise only into the region to be inpainted. Our implementation is based on the method proposed by CT-Palette in [ 10 ] , with modifications adapted to our experimental settings.
blocks.zh: CT-帕莱特: 一个有条件的传播模型,通过在截断的图像和面具上同时进行调节来预测完整的未切换的重建,显示用来从地面真理中生成截断的图像的图像部分. 我们只给这个地区注入了噪音,以便涂上油漆。 我们的实施是基于CT-Palette在[10]中提出的方法,并根据我们的实验环境进行了修改。

blocks.en: INR-based Projection Correction (INR-PC-IR): A fast conditional 3D wavelet diffusion model [ 3 ] was trained on the INR extended projections of size 256 × 256 × 256 256\times 256\times 256 . The projections generated by the diffusion model were subsequently interpolated to yield projections of size 300 × 256 × 256 300\times 256\times 256 to compare with the ground truth. The original projection data from the uncropped FOV were incorporated into the diffusion model–corrected projections and volumetric images were subsequently reconstructed using OS-SART.
blocks.zh: 基于INR的预测校正(INR-PC-IR): 快速有条件的3D波波传播模型[3]接受了关于INR扩展预测大小256×256×256×256×256×256×256×256的训练. 扩散模型产生的预测随后被内插,得出大小为300×256×256300×256的预测,与地面真理比较. 将未整理的FOV的原始投影数据纳入了扩散模型——修正的预测,随后利用OS-SART重建了体积图像。

blocks.en: Ablation 1: INR-based Iterative Reconstruction (INR-IR): The projections rendered by the INR were reconstructed using OS-SART, without applying the diffusion-based refinement stage of our proposed method. Before the reconstruction, we copied the original projection data corresponding to the uncropped FOV into the INR-rendered projections.
blocks.zh: 1: 以INR为基础的迭代重建(INR-IR): 国际自然资源研究所所作的预测是使用OS-SART进行重建的,没有采用我们拟议方法的推广改进阶段。 在重建前,我们把对应未整理的FOV的原始投影数据复制到INR的投影中.

blocks.en: Ablation 2: Iterative Reconstruction-Prior DDPM (IR-DDPM): We used the cropped ground truth projections directly as input to the OS-SART algorithm and used the resulting volumetric images as conditions to train the fast diffusion model described in Section 2.2 .
blocks.zh: 参考文献2:迭代重建-先发制人: 我们直接将所裁剪的地面真象预测作为OS-SART算法的输入,并将所产生的量子图像作为条件来训练第2.2节所述的快速扩散模型。

blocks.en: IR Prior-WDM (IR-WDM): The iterative reconstruction using cropped projections was refined using a 3D diffusion model approach based on fastWDM [ 3 ] trained in the reconstructed image domain.
blocks.zh: IR President-WDM(IR-WDM): 利用栽培的预测进行的迭代重建利用基于快速WDM[3]在重建图像领域培训的三维传播模型方法进行了改进。

blocks.en: INR Prior-WDM (INR-IR-WDM): The INR-based iterative reconstruction (INR-IR) was refined using a 3D diffusion model approach based on fastWDM [ 3 ] trained in the reconstructed image domain.
blocks.zh: INR President-WDM(INR-IR-WDM): (英语). 基于INR的迭代重建(INR-IR)是使用基于快速WDM[3]在重建图像领域培训的3D扩散模型方法加以改进的.

blocks.en: INR Prior-DDPM (INR-IR-DDPM) (proposed): The diffusion-based refinement was applied to the INR-based iterative reconstruction (INR-IR) using a fast DDPM model in 2D described in Section 2.2 .
blocks.zh: INR POR-DDPM(IR-IR-DDPM)(拟议): 基于传播的改进应用到基于IR的迭代重建(INR-IR)中使用了第2.2节描述的2D中的快速DDPM模型.

The boundary between the non-truncated and truncated FOV is indicated by a black dotted circle in the ground truth image. We show only a selection of the evaluated methods.
blocks.zh: 图 2: MMDental数据集(第1至2行)和猪下巴数据集(第3至4行)上评价方法的质量比较. 非圆点和短点FOV的边界由地面真像中的黑色圆点表示. 我们只展示一些经过评估的方法。

blocks.en: 3 Results
blocks.zh: 3 结果

blocks.en:
We quantitatively evaluated whole-image reconstructions using mean absolute error (MAE), structural similarity index measure (SSIM), peak signal-to-noise ratio (PSNR) and learned perceptual image patch similarity. The results are summarized in Table 1 . Visualization of the results is provided in Fig 2 . We reconstructed the ground truth with the iterative OS-SART algorithm using the uncropped projections. Compared with FDK, iterative algorithms reduce truncation artifacts but fail to accurately recover structures beyond the original FOV. Incorporating TV regularization results in blurring because the regularization suppresses high-frequency components of the image. CT-Palette hallucinates structures in the extended regions (see insets in Fig. 2 ) and suffers from slow sampling because of the many diffusion steps. The INR-based projection correction (INR-PC-IR), performs well at modeling structures beyond the original FOV. However, the reconstructed images exhibit slight blurring.
The INR-based iterative reconstruction (INR-IR) outperforms iterative reconstructions with cropped projections; however, it fails to recover small structures outside the original FOV. The addition of the DDPM-based correction (INR-IR-DDPM) enhances the recovery of structural detail in these regions. A similar improvement is observed when the DDPM-based refinement is applied to the OS-SART reconstruction (IR-DDPM). In this case, the diffusion model successfully eliminates truncation artifacts and preserves structural detail. Replacing the 2D DDPM with 3D fastWDM yields good performance but increases blurring in the extended FOV.
blocks.zh:
我们利用平均绝对错误(MAE),结构相似度指数度量(SSIM),峰值信号对噪比(PSNR)和所学知觉图像补丁相似度,对全图像重建进行定量评价. 表1汇总了结果。 图2提供了结果的可视化情况。 我们用迭代的OS-SART算法 重建了地面真理 利用了未铺设的预测 与FDK相比,迭代算法减少了径流文物,但未能准确回收超出原FOV的结构. 纳入电视规范化导致模糊不清,因为规范化抑制了图像的高频组件. CT-Palette在扩展区域产生幻觉结构(见图2中的内设),由于扩散步骤很多,取样速度缓慢。 基于INR的投影校正(INR-PC-IR),在原FOV以外的建模结构上表现良好. 然而,重建后的图像略显模糊.
基于INR的迭代重建(INR-IR)在被裁剪的预测下超过了迭代重建;然而,它未能在原FOV之外恢复小型结构. 增加了基于DDPM的校正(INR-IR-DDPM),加强了这些区域的结构细节的恢复. 在基于DDPM的改进适用于OS-SART重建(IR-DDPM)时也观察到类似的改进. 在这种情况下,扩散模型成功地消除了断流文物,保留了结构细节. 用3D快WDM取代2D DDPM能产生良好的性能,但在扩展的FOV中会增加模糊度.

blocks.en: We trained the DDPM model conditioned on the INR prior using 2, 3 and 1000 diffusion steps and compared their performance (see Table 1 ). Increasing the number of diffusion steps from 2 to 3 yields a substantial improvement in performance. The highest performance is achieved by the diffusion model with 1000 diffusion steps. However, its sampling time of ≈ 2.2 h \approx$2.2\text{\,}\mathrm{h}$ per volume makes it impractical for clinical use. We therefore propose the model with 3 diffusion steps, which achieves the second-best performance while requiring only 25 s 25\text{\,}\mathrm{s} . Furthermore, Table 1 reports the average runtimes for the evaluated methods. For the generative models CT-Palette, fastWDM and DDPM, the reported times correspond to the generation of an entire volumetric image. For the INR, the reported time includes both the optimization of the INR until convergence and the subsequent sampling of the extended projections. The iterative algorithms required approximately 4–6 minutes per reconstruction.
blocks.zh: 我们培训了DDPM模型,其条件先是使用2、3和1000个传播步骤,然后比较其性能(见表1)。 将传播步骤的数目从2个增加到3个,使业绩大有改善。 最高性能是通过具有1000个扩散步骤的扩散模型实现的. 然而,它的采样时间为每卷2.2 h\\ 大约2.2\ text\,\ mathrm{h}$,因此临床用途不切实际。 因此,我们提出有3个传播步骤的模型,它实现了第二佳的性能,同时只需要25 s 25\text~,}\mathrm{s}. 此外,表1报告了所评价方法的平均运行时间。 对于基因模型CT-Palette,fastWDM和DDPM,报告时间对应整个卷状图像的生成. 就国家自然资源研究所而言,报告的时间既包括优化国家自然资源研究所直至汇合,也包括随后对延长的预测进行取样。 迭代算法每次重建需要约4-6分钟.

blocks.zh: 表1:平均±\\pm标准差. 最佳和次最佳成果分别以黑体和下划线突出。 T. DDPM运行时间结果报告为T=2/3/1000。

blocks.en: 4 Discussion and Conclusion
blocks.zh: 讨论和结论

blocks.en: The INR-based reconstruction (INR-IR) provides a substantially stronger prior for the DDPM input compared to the OS-SART result, as evidenced by the quantitative evaluation. Nevertheless, the INR-IR-DDPM and IR-DDPM methods achieve comparable performance on the MMDental dataset, highlighting the strong correction capability of the DDPM. In contrast, for the pig jaw dataset, incorporating the INR prior leads to a more pronounced performance gain, indicating that the INR prior is particularly beneficial in this setting.
blocks.zh: 与OS-SART结果相比,基于IR-IR的重建为DDPM投入提供了更强大的前身,定量评价就证明了这一点. 尽管如此,IR-IR-DDPM和IR-DDPM方法在MMDental数据集上取得了可比较的性能,突出了DDPM强大的校正能力. 相比之下,对于猪下巴数据集来说,纳入INR前导数据会导致更显著的性能增益,表明INR前导数据在此背景下特别有益.

blocks.en: Although diffusion-based corrections are fast ( ≈ 25 s \approx$25\text{\,}\mathrm{s}$ ), the prolonged INR optimization ( ≈ 20 min \approx$20\text{\,}\mathrm{min}$ ) remains a limitation. Future work could accelerate training, e.g., through meta-learning-based initialization.
blocks.zh: 虽然基于传播的校正速度快(≈ 25 s\ 约$25\ text~,}\ mathrm{s}$),但长时间的INR优化(≈ 20 分钟\ 约$20\ text~,}\ mathrm{min}$)仍然是一个限制. 今后的工作可以加快培训,例如通过以元学习为基础的初始化。

blocks.en: Despite strong image quality, further improvements may be achieved through end-to-end integration of neural rendering and diffusion-based correction, followed by validation on clinical scans with real projection data.
blocks.zh: 尽管图像质量很强,但可以通过将神经渲染和基于传播的校正进行端到端的整合,然后用真实的投影数据进行临床扫描验证,从而实现进一步的改进.

blocks.en: To summarize, we propose a novel three-stage framework for truncated CBCT FOV extension that consists of INR-based truncated projection extension, iterative reconstruction and diffusion model-based image correction, which formulates the task as an image-to-image translation problem. Our proposed method demonstrated strong performance, as evidenced by both the quantitative image metrics and the qualitative visual results.
blocks.zh: 概括地说,我们提出一个小说三阶段框架,用于截断的CBCT FOV扩展,它包括基于INR的截断投影扩展,迭代重建以及基于模型的传播图像校正,它将任务设定为图像到图像的翻译问题. 我们提议的方法显示出强有力的表现,量化图像衡量尺度和定性视觉结果都证明了这一点。
